item.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 3 Episode 4 Scores An Astounding 9.8 On IMDb, Highest Rated In Series History
item.description: Jujutsu Kaisen's latest episode "Perfect Preparation" scores a 9.8/10 on IMDb, making it the top episode in the series and tied for second-highest anime episode ever.

item.title: Universal Studios Japan To Debut New Immersive Pokémon Experience With Global Rollout Planned
item.description: Universal Studios Japan and The Pokémon Company announce a major new interactive Pokémon attraction debuting in Osaka before expanding worldwide.

item.title: Japan's Agency For Cultural Affairs Drops New Anti-Piracy Ad Featuring Decades Of Anime & Manga Icons
item.description: The New STOP! Manga Piracy ad from Japan's Agency for Cultural Affairs spotlights heroes like Astro Boy, Luffy, JoJo, Goku, Gundam, and Tanjiro urging fans to support official releases of manga and anime.

item.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA - WALPURGISNACHT: RISING Film Delayed Again, New Date Coming In February 2026
item.description: Puella Magi Madoka Magica sequel film Walpurgisnacht: Rising pushed back from February 2026 due to production issues. New release date announcement expected next month.

item.title: Manga Mavericks Books Starts 2026 Off With Four Fresh Digital Manga Titles
item.description: Manga Mavericks Books kicks off 2026 with digital releases of Path From Tanuki Temple, Fishgod, Horon Of The Closed Country, and Ballet Hero Fantasy. All new manga series that span across genres.

item.title: DRAGON BALL SUPER: Sequel Anime Officially Confirmed As Goku And Vegeta Join THE GALACTIC PATROL
item.description: After many long years and the tragic passing of Akira Toriyama, the Dragon Ball Super TV anime has finally confirmed its return. Read on for the details.

item.title: Toei Announces DRAGON BALL SUPER Remake Of BATTLE OF GODS And Sets Release Date
item.description: Huge news from Genkidamatsuri! Dragon Ball Super returns in 2026 with a high-quality remake of the Battle of Gods arc. Get the latest anime details here.

item.title: DRAGON BALL: AGE 1000 Video Game Project Announced At Genkidamatsuri 2026
item.description: In addition to two big announcements concerning the Dragon Ball Super anime, - an intriguing new video game project was also revealed at Genkidamatsuri.

item.title: South Korea's AI Basic Act Sparks Debate In Webtoon Industry With New Rules For AI-Generated Content
item.description: South Korea enacts a new comprehensive AI law, requiring clear disclosure of AI-generated content which includes watermarks with a one-year grace period for Webtoon creators and platforms.

item.title: DRAGON BALL's Iconic Majin Buu Voice Actor Has Passed Away
item.description: Kōzō Shioya, the veteran voice actor behind Majin Buu in Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball Super, died January 20th, 2026, at 71 years old due to cerebral hemorrhage.
